verdict.rationale: LocalAI's built-in web interface covers managing installations, and models can be installed from the Discover gallery page or listed via the CLI. Model aliasing offers a light form of per-model setup, and chats keep editable saved messages. However, nothing shows a saved-prompt library or a single UI for editing per-model configurations, so only the model-management part of the story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: a saved/reusable prompt library, a per-model configuration editor in the same UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a unified management view.
